assumptions.claim: The Raffle clone has been initialized prior to onERC721Received so that prizeToken and sponsor are non-zero addresses and status is Status.AwaitingPrize (whereas the implementation contract is locked in Status.Refunding).
Calling contract msg.sender (prizeToken) only invokes onERC721Received(factory, sponsor, prizeTokenId, ...) during a genuine transfer that vests ownership of prizeTokenId in the Raffle clone.
assumptions.establishedBy: RaffleFactory.createRaffle checks prize.ownerOf(params.prizeTokenId) == raffle and IRaffle(raffle).status() == IRaffle.Status.Active immediately after prize.safeTransferFrom (packages/contracts/src/RaffleFactory.sol:L128-L134) and checks IERC165.supportsInterface(type(IERC721).interfaceId) (packages/contracts/src/RaffleFactory.sol:L171-L177); ongoing standards-compliant ERC-721 custody behavior of the arbitrary prizeToken contract is established by nothing found

assumptions.claim: prizeToken.safeTransferFrom invokes IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received directly without requiring IERC165.supportsInterface(type(IERC721Receiver).interfaceId) to return true on the Raffle clone (ERC721.supportsInterface at packages/contracts/node_modules/@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC721/ERC721.sol:L45-L50 does not include IERC721Receiver).

callers: Any external caller or ERC-721 contract directly via the external entrypoint (packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L416-L419)

invariants.claim: onERC721Received reverts with UnexpectedPrize unless status == Status.AwaitingPrize, msg.sender == address(prizeToken), tokenId == prizeTokenId, from == sponsor, and operator == factory.

On success, status transitions from Status.AwaitingPrize to Status.Active, PrizeDeposited(msg.sender, tokenId, from) is emitted, and IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received.selector (0x150b7a02) is returned.
onERC721Received can succeed at most once per Raffle clone because it transitions status to Status.Active and no function ever sets status back to Status.AwaitingPrize after one-time initialization.
